runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$1.50** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares 220,445,015 common on the cover of the 10-Q for Q2 2026 (0001104659-26-092061, filed 2026-08-06), checked against 220,358,166 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, no treasury shares; market cap $330.7M; the Amazon warrant (58.8M at $13.49), the Stonepeak warrant (20.1M at $5.50 and $6.50), options and RSUs all out of the money. Sovereign for the earnings currency (USD) **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-16. Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (0001104659-26-019215, filed 2026-02-24), the 10-Q for Q2 2026, the DEF 14A of 2026-04-30, the 8-Ks of the CEO, COO and CFO successions and of the two TotalEnergies directors' resignations (2025-11-21), and the 10-Ks for FY2023, FY2020 and FY2017 for the cash-flow history. Cross-check: 2025 operating cash $85,529 thousand on the filed statement agrees with `tools/run.py`. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. **The deciding fact:** about 40% of 2025 gross margin ($45.3M of RIN and LCFS credits against $114.9M) is government-created credit; the AFTC, $20.7M to $23.8M a year, expired at the end of 2024 and was not renewed; demand turns on which drivetrain heavy trucks adopt under shifting federal and California rules, and the filer itself says "it is difficult to accurately predict demand for our vehicle fuels" and that adoption has "been slower than we anticipated". **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the ten-year forecast is one the insiders will not write down, and more work would not produce it; no research pass opened. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: net loss in ten of the last eleven years, operating income negative every year 2009 to 2025 except 2018 and 2019, accumulated deficit $1,234.6M, goodwill of $64.3M written off in 2025; about $376M put into dairy-RNG joint ventures and digester equipment 2021 to 2025, producing 2.7M GGEs in 2025 against 300.1M sold; Pilot, the largest LNG station customer, not renewed; equity held up by issuance (TotalEnergies 2018 $83.4M, an at-the-market program 2021 $204.5M, the Stonepeak warrant $42.4M, Amazon warrant charges $295.4M 2021 to 2025); debt a $250M Stonepeak loan at 9.50% due 2029-12-12 with $15.0M of 2025 interest paid in kind; cash and short-term investments $140.2M at 2026-06-30; the 10-K names no rival, OPAL Fuels and Montauk Renewables chosen as a CONVENTION of the run (2021 to 2025 operating margin CLNE -21.6%, OPAL 4.1%, Montauk 10.0%); **integrity facts recorded, not judged**: the CEO's bonus at 111% of salary in a $222.0M loss year on Adjusted EBITDA targets set below the prior year's actual, new CEO, COO and CFO in 2026, both TotalEnergies directors resigned 2025. Owner cash (2021 to 2025 average, `tools/run.py` recast by hand for the ADG equipment and JV lines in capital spending, the Amazon warrant in stock pay and $54.4M of one-time Pilot removal charges in 2025 depreciation): +$1.3M before interest on the maintenance guess, -$6.4M after interest, -$75.8M with all capital spending. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value range -$6.85 to -$0.40 a share all-equity (-$6.98 to -$0.53 equity-only) against $1.50, fair price -$2.20 all-equity (-$2.04 equity-only), no case earns the floor; not armed. Contamination declared by the analyst: a listing of `Test Runs/` filtered on today's date (names of other 2026-10-17 runs, none of this company), a fold commit subject, a memory index line and the lock file's presence, none used. Commits 17767c2d (Step 0 and Q1), 1e3d2fb2 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check 37 ids, no E-ids; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 37 ids, 14 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): whether a government-created credit is a commodity price (Q1 passes, Q2 likely OUT) or a regulator's decision the insiders will not forecast (Q1 TOO HARD, NATURE), a second analyst could close OUT at Q2 on the same evidence; warrants given to a customer and booked as contra-revenue; an expired subsidy in the base years; a negative fair price; `tools/run.py`'s capital-spending and stock-pay columns on this filer.
